question.text: While titration dilute <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>HCI</mi></math> solution with aqueous <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>NaOH</mi></math>, which of the following will not be required ?

solution.text:
In this acid base Titrating there is no use of Bunsen burner and measuring cylinder other laboratory equipments will be required for getting the end point of titration.

These are the equipment required for titration.

  • Burette
  • Conical flask
  • Beaker
  • Pipette
  • Stirring rod
  • Small (filter) funnel
  • Burette stand and clamp (note 2)
  • White tile 
  • Indicator
